content.text:
Working. Here's the full picture of what `bun run dev:cf` now gives you:

**What works:**
- Full UI loads (React SPA with client-side routing via Workers Assets)
- All core API routes — companies, agents, issues, projects, routines, goals, approvals, costs, activity, dashboard, auth session, instance settings, etc.
- Auth session (`/api/auth/get-session`) returns the local board user in `local_trusted` mode

**Expected 501s** (Node.js-only features not yet ported to CF):
- `/api/adapters` / `/api/plugins/*` — plugin system uses child processes
- `/api/companies/:id/skills` — CfCompanySkillsService exists but no route wired yet
- `/api/companies/:id/events/ws` — real-time WebSocket (needs Durable Objects)
- `/api/companies/:id/join-requests` + `user-directory` — in `access.ts`, which reads SKILL.md from disk

**One prerequisite:** you need to build the UI once before starting (`pnpm --filter @paperclipai/ui build`), since `dev:cf` only runs the worker bundler. If you want live UI + CF API simultaneously, run `pnpm dev:ui` and `pnpm dev:cf` side by side (but the CF mode will serve the pre-built assets, not the vite dev server).
